turns.teacher: Pari, chlorine ka use drinking water ko germs se saaf karne mein hota hai. Iodine antiseptic ke roop mein chhote cuts par lagaya ja sakta hai. Ab aap dono uses apne words mein batayiye.

guard.firstDraft: Pari, aapne sahi pakda—maine sawaal repeat kiya. Ab rukte hain; aapka break lijiye. Goodbye, aur apna dhyaan rakhiye.

end.summary:
Discussed uses of non-metals through guided questions.
Covered oxygen for breathing and hospital oxygen support.
Discussed nitrogen’s role in plant protein formation and growth.
Identified graphite as a solid non-metal used in pencils; chlorine and iodine were not covered.
Teach-back was not completed; no misconception was recorded.
end.parentNote: Pari practised linking oxygen with breathing and hospital oxygen support, nitrogen with plant protein formation, and graphite with pencil use. They recalled these examples after the break, using everyday connections such as pencils and oxygen cylinders. No factual mix-up was recorded, but the teach-back was not completed. At home, ask Pari to make a three-column list of non-metals, their form, and one use, including oxygen, nitrogen, graphite, chlorine, and iodine.
